fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! Moses says, "…the LORD is their inheritance, as He promised them." (Deuteronomy 18:2) The Levites have no inheritance among their brothers, but they have Him. And Moses says He is the One who promised it. The LORD Himself is what they get.

problems.problem: “No land to call their own” goes beyond the passage. It says the Levites have no inheritance among their brothers, not that they cannot own land.
